### The Potter and the Clay
Author: Robin Dugall
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/the-potter-and-the-clay-homeword-jamuary-30.html
Passage: Jeremiah 18:6
Points:
- God actively shapes and works His people like a potter molding clay into a purposeful vessel.
- Painful and difficult circumstances are often the precise moments when the Potter is shaping us.
- Clay must remain soft and pliable so the craftsman can turn ordinary earth into a thing of beauty.
- God's transformation is an ongoing daily process requiring trust rather than worry about the future.

### Who Needs a Do-Over?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-january-9-2021.html
Passage: Jeremiah 18:3-4
Points:
- God is the Master Workman who takes ordinary and flawed human lives to reshape them.
- When a vessel becomes marred, the Potter does not discard it but lovingly makes it again.
- Every turn of the potter's wheel remains purposeful under God's overruling sovereignty.
- Believers who feel damaged or broken should look to Christ in faith for renewal.

### In the Potter’s Hands
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/in-the-potter-s-hands-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-september-17-2015.html
Passage: Jeremiah 18:5-6
Points:
- God has a sovereign design for every life and treats His people as clay on the wheel.
- Each person faces a choice to either yield to God's molding hands or resist His guidance.
- Those who stubbornly oppose the Lord risk ending up in ruin like discarded, broken pottery.
- Yielding to God allows Him to turn our lives into what He originally designed them to be.

### The Potter’s Wheel
Author: Leslie Snyder
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/the-potters-wheel-homeword-june-12.html
Passage: Jeremiah 18:3-6
Points:
- Shaping clay into a masterpiece requires patience, vision, energy, and careful centering.
- People frequently try to take control and direct God rather than surrendering to His wisdom.
- The believer's role is to remain pliable clay while God acts as the sovereign artisan.
- Enduring God's shaping and refining process produces a vessel fit for His glory.
